new.note: Statistics can now be viewed year by year.
New charts: which hours of the day and which days of the week you listen.
Recap: a slideshow of a year or a month, opened from the statistics page.
Duel tournaments: seed 8, 16 or 32 tracks by rating and play the bracket out.
SongGuessr can now be played within one artist or one album.
Every play now records the hour it happened, which is what the new hour chart reads.

fixed.note: Removing songs no longer erases their duel ratings or their place in a tierlist.
Importing the same stats file twice no longer counts a listen twice.
Hide the window at startup now works when the app is launched at login.
A failed deletion is now reported instead of passing silently.
Keeping the screen awake no longer depends on the battery animation setting.
A metadata provider outage is no longer reported as no results found.
Saved .lrc files are tagged with Nemora, and files with the old tag still read.

knownIssues.note: Editing tags is supported for MP3 only, as in Nora.

fixed.note: Importing stats no longer fails on creating a backup.
Listening history now survives a rebuilt library instead of detaching from it.
Removing songs no longer erases their listening history.
Statistics no longer mix tracks in your library with tracks that left it.
A track the player refuses to open is now repaired and retried instead of showing an error.

knownIssues.note: Editing tags is supported for MP3 only, as in Nora.

fixed.note: Show in file explorer now selects the file instead of only opening its folder.
Right click no longer opens the webview context menu.
Opening a file from Explorer while minimized now restores the window.

knownIssues.note: Editing tags is supported for MP3 only, as in Nora.

new.note: First release. Nora's core in a Tauri shell: a twelfth of the disk space, roughly half the memory, and a fraction of the CPU while a track plays.
Tierlists, ELO duels and SongGuessr, a statistics tab that exports, a smart shuffle weighted by your own rankings, and a Rediscover playlist for music you loved and stopped hearing.
Search that forgives typos and finds text nobody can type as written, across scripts and keyboard layouts.
Music folders are watched, so tracks added, changed or deleted outside Nemora appear without a manual resync.
Everything from a Nora profile can be imported in one action, from Settings > About. Nora's own data is only ever read.

knownIssues.note: Editing tags is supported for MP3 only, as in Nora.

developerUpdates.note: Track metadata is parsed in a worker rather than on the interface thread, and embedded cover art is found even when it sits past the first 256 KB of a file.
